info.title: BFD_Session
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

bfd_min_rx_interval.description: Minimum RX interval in ms configured for this particular BFD session. If this field is left empty, the system will use the port-specific (if any) or the global system value. If this value is zero, the system does not want to receive any periodic BFD Control packets.

bfd_min_tx_interval.description: Minimum TX interval in ms configured for this particular BFD session. If this field is left empty, the system will use the port-specific (if any) or the global system value. The value zero is reserved.

diagnostic.description: In case of a problem, set to an error message that reports what the local BFD session thinks is wrong. The error messages are defined in section 4.1 of [RFC 5880].

dst_ip.description:
Reference Resource: [BFD_Session](#/BFD_Session)
Destination address of the session.

dst_mac.description: Set to an Ethernet address in the form xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx to set the MAC used as destination for transmitted BFD packets. The BFD session will not be operational until this field is populated.

effective_min_rx_interval.description: BFD session operational min_rx interval as determined after the session negotiation with remote endpoint.

effective_min_tx_interval.description: BFD session operational min_tx interval as determined after the session negotiation with remote endpoint.

egress_phy_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
The physical port on which BFD packets are transmitted. For route-only ports and LAGs it the same as src_port. For VLANs, it is the actual member port. The BFD session will not be operational until this field is populated.

from.description:
Reference Resource: [BFD_Session](#/BFD_Session)
Protocol that requested the session.

from_instance_id.description:
Reference Resource: [BFD_Session](#/BFD_Session)
Instance ID of the protocol that requested the session.

inner_dst_mac.description: Set to an Ethernet address in the form xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx to set the MAC used as inner destination for transmitted BFD packets in VXLAN sessions. The VXLAN originated BFD session will not be operational until this field is populated.

local_discriminator.description: BFD session local discriminator value. The BFD session will not be operational until this field is populated.

operating_mode.description:
Reference Resource: [BFD_Session](#/BFD_Session)
'async': Control packets only 'async_and_echo': Control and (optionally) echo packets 'async_vxlan': Control packets within a VXLAN tunnel

protocol_disabled.description: The client protocol for this session has administratively disabled BFD. If the BFD session is not shared, BFD will start sending packets with state admin down for at least a detect multiplier time interval.

remote_min_echo_rx_interval.description: BFD session remote operational echo min_rx interval as detected by the local endpoint.

remote_min_rx_interval.description: BFD session remote operational min_rx interval as detected by the local endpoint.

remote_min_tx_interval.description: BFD session remote operational min_tx interval as detected by the local endpoint.

remote_multiplier.description: BFD session remote operational multiplier as detected by the local endpoint.

selected_src_ip.description: Since BFD sessions can have multiple IPs on the source port, the following selection algorithm is used: * IPv4:  1. Use the primary address if it matches the destination subnet.  2. Use the secondary address if it matches the destination subnet. * IPv6:  1. Use the link-local address if the remote source IP is also a     link-local  2. Use an IP from the non local-link addresses based on the     destination subnet.

session_id.description: BFD session identifier. The BFD session will not be operational until this field is populated.

src_ip.description: Source address for transmitted BFD control packets. If not present, the address from the src_port is used.

src_port.description:
Reference Resource: [BFD_Session](#/BFD_Session)
The source of the BFD session. Might be empty for multi-hop sessions. The BFD session will not be operational until this field is populated.

state.description: The state of the session 'admin_down':   the session is being administratively down. 'down':         the session is down or has just been created. 'init':         remote system is communicating, and the local system desires                 to bring the session up, but the remote system does not yet realize it. 'up':           the session is fully healthy and negotiated.

async.description: The state of the local asynchronous session.

echo.description: The state of the local echo session.

remote.description: The state of the remote session -- including asynchronous and echo.

session.description: The state of the entire local session -- including asynchronous and echo.

control_dropped.description: Number of BFD control packets dropped.

control_rx.description: Number of BFD control packets received.

control_tx.description: Number of BFD control packets transmitted.

flap_count.description: Counts the number of bfd_status:state flaps since start. A flap is considered as a change of the state value from Up to Down.

capacity.description: System resources availability for the session. The BFD session will not be operational until resources are allocated.

hardware_id.description: Identifier of the BFD session that was allocated in the hardware.

hw_programming.description: Status of the BFD session in hardware.

num_retries_performed.description: Number of times the retries have been performed to the hardware.

num_retries_requested.description: Number of retries requested for configuring this session in hardware.

safe_to_delete.description: BFD has performed its finalizing actions (if any) and the session is ready to be deleted.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
